title: Stability derivative at one
statement: For any real-valued function $f$ on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, let $\widehat f(S)$ denote its uniform Fourier coefficients and define the stability curve $S_f(\rho)=\sum_{A\subseteq[n]}\rho^{|A|}\widehat f(A)^2$. Define $I(f)=\sum_{i=1}^n\mathbb{E}[((f(x^{i,+})-f(x^{i,-}))/2)^2]$, where $x^{i,+}$ and $x^{i,-}$ are obtained by setting coordinate $i$ to $+1$ and $-1$, respectively. Then $S_f'(1)=I(f)$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube
